Features
Equip your business with tools to boost sales, hire top talent, enhance credibility, and access exclusive market insights.

Premium Business elevates and distinguishes organizations and their affiliates on >x<. Gold checkmarks, square avatars, and custom affiliation badges verify and differentiate you and your entities main account, spokespeople and subsidiary accounts. Affiliations are not included in our Basic tier. We will continue to improve our service and may change our features from time to time.

>x< reserves the right without notice to remove your checkmark or other badging at any time at its sole discretion, including if you violate our Purchaser Terms, Terms of Service, and policies, or if your account is suspended or violates any of our rules or policies.
Premium Business Portal

The Premium Business portal lets organizations add and remove affiliated accounts, for Full Access tier subscribers, and provides immediate verification status to anyone in their network who accepts their invitation to affiliate. This could be for new employees, a newly launched movie franchise, or recent team changes for professional sports groups.
Learn more about how to use the Premium Business portal here.
Affiliations

The best marketing comes directly from real people on >x<. Now, you can affiliate your organization’s champions so that everyone knows where they work. Affiliates receive a small image of their organization's account profile picture next to their name every time they post, send a DM, or appear in search. Affiliation is not available in the Basic tier.

You can affiliate anyone who represents or is associated with your organization: leadership, journalists, sports teams and players, politicians, customer support, franchises, sub-brands, products and so on. An account you invite to affiliate must accept your invitation before they receive the affiliation badge.
Custom Organization Profile

Premium Business accounts receive a number of customizations to their profile. In addition to gold checkmarks, businesses also receive a square avatar, clearly distinguishing them from other organizations.
All Premium Business Full Access accounts also receive a new tab on their profile that lists all affiliated accounts. This appears next to the posts tab and displays any affiliated accounts.

With affiliation badges and the affiliation tab, this makes it easy for visitors to click on the badge of an affiliate, arrive at the organization’s profile, and see all the other affiliated accounts in one place. Affiliation is not available in the Basic tier.
Impersonation Defense

All Premium Business and affiliated accounts are defended against impersonation. Accounts are monitored for changes (including display names, profile photos, and usernames) and flagged for further review if impersonation is detected.
Priority Support
Premium Business accounts have access to a Priority Support team directly from their Premium Business portal. Full Access subscribers receive the fastest level of support and escalation.

Businesses experiencing issues, including with onboarding, removing or adding affiliates, billing, or issues with impersonation of your accounts, can contact Priority Support and we will ensure you timely support and escalations.

Premium Business Priority Support is reserved for the Premium Business itself and its affiliates only. Submitting requests on behalf of other accounts is considered misuse of the feature and may result in loss of access.
Elevated post, DM, and media upload limits

Premium Business accounts and their affiliates have significantly elevated post, DM, and media upload rate limits. Premium Business subscribers can use this to provide seamless customer support, live-post events, or run auto-response campaigns.
Radar (Beta)
We’re excited to introduce Radar. Monitor keywords, track conversations, and stay on top of trends you care about.
Radar is available to Premium Business accounts with a limited version available to Premium+ users. Full Access subscribers receive the highest number of queries available.
>x< Premium+

All accounts (the main account and its affiliates) subscribed to Premium Business will receive all the benefits of >x< Premium+. You’ll get access to features like SuperGrok, Radar, Edit post, Bookmark Folders, Longer posts, Prioritized rankings in replies, and Reduced ads.*
See more on >x< Premium+

Criteria for eligibility
An organization must provide a matching active >x< account, current organization email address, and current website domain when they sign up.
An organization must have access to and manage the matching active account they wish to verify. They will be required to authenticate your account when they activate their new subscription.
An organization's profile must be complete with an accurate profile photo, bio, and display name.
Only organization accounts (such as businesses, non-profits and political parties) are allowed on Premium Business.
Personal or individual accounts are not allowed on Premium Business. Some exceptions can be made for certain businesses built around personal brands, which our team assesses on a case-by-case basis.
We support credit card payments only.

b: Accounts which sign up for Premium Business but are not an organization account will not be refunded.
